title: Social Monitor: Romania ranks last in EU for artificial intelligence use
summary: Romania ranks last in the European Union for the use of artificial intelligence by both individuals and companies, according to an analysis by the Social Monitor (Monitorul Social), a project of Friedrich-Ebert-Stiftung Romania. The report linked the low adoption rate to a wider deficit in basic digital skills. Only 17.8% of Romanians aged 16 to 74 used generative AI tools in 2025, compared with an EU average of 32.7%. Denmark led the bloc with a rate of 48.4%, according to Eurostat data cited in the report. The difference was greater in the workplace. title: Dutch adventurer drives late friend’s Volvo across Europe for new purpose in Romania
summary: A 2005 Volvo XC70 with more than 550,000 km on the clock has been crossing Europe on a final journey inspired by its late owner. Dutch photographer, writer, and wilderness guide Thijs Heslenfeld is now heading toward Romania, where he hopes to donate his close friend Fleur’s car to an organization providing medical services in communities with limited access to healthcare. Heslenfeld, 61, left his hometown of Driebergen, near Utrecht, on October 22 and reached Istanbul on November 2.
